query:
WITH released AS (
            DELETE FROM edges e
            USING nodes n
            WHERE e.to_node_id = $2 AND e.kind = 'part_of'
              AND n.id = e.to_node_id AND n.user_id = $1
            RETURNING e.from_node_id
        )
        UPDATE nodes SET canvas_x = NULL, canvas_y = NULL
        WHERE id IN (SELECT from_node_id FROM released)
